_comment: FROZEN evaluation surface -- reviewer-only, uploaded FRESH under /tests at scoring and NOT baked into the task image. the baked root-0700 /opt/verifier copy of this manifest, of compute_reward.py and of heldout_samples.jsonl was REMOVED from the image (the container runs as uid 0, so root-0700 was no protection); the held-out sample set now ships with tests/ and its sha256 is pinned in thresholds.heldout_samples_sha256 so the timed workload is provably the one ref_speedup was calibrated on. compute_reward.py reads thresholds from here.
heldout_data_provenance: Synthetic-but-realistic lm-eval scoring records generated deterministically at Docker build (build_dataset.py) from a fixed seed: each record is one eval instance carrying the harness-produced model OUTPUTS (generated text or per-choice loglikelihoods), the requested filter pipeline (regex extraction + take_first / majority_vote), the metric name (exact_match / contains / prefix_match / loglikelihood_acc), and the gold target. The agent-visible DEV split under /data is a DISJOINT sample pool with the SAME schema. The HELD-OUT split's gold + ids ship ONLY with the fresh tests/ upload at scoring (byte-identical to the authoring-time build output, sha256 pinned in thresholds.heldout_samples_sha256) and are never present in the task image at all.

calibration_record.calibrated_on: CPU-only session, 8 vCPU / 32 GiB, gpus=0 (Intel Sapphire Rapids)
calibration_record.protocol: VERIFIER_MODE=strong_baseline through tests/test.sh 3x;每次调用本身已经是 timing_repeats=5 次计时的中位数，所以锚点是 median-of-medians。整条阶梯（起步模板 / 负控 / 三个 ceiling）在同一 session、同一台机器上量，保证与锚点可比。

starter_template.what: 镜像里发的起步模板（逐行 Python 循环，正确但慢）

negative_skipping_scorer.what: 跳样本的负控：一致性门必须把它判 0

calibration_record.rebuild_note: 2026-07-26 19:40 重烤：把校准后的锚点烤进 /opt/verifier 兜底副本。冻结面三个文件与校准时逐字节相同（只有兜底副本层变了），所以校准阶梯无需重测；镜像内三档自检：起步模板 reward 0.9913、强基线 1.0644、跳样本负控 0.0（一致性 0.9）。

threshold_notes: {'timing_repeats': 'number of timed passes; take the median. Raise if the host shows high variance; confirm noise_floor << baseline_time.', 'min_speedup_plausible': 'anti-noise floor; confirm the naive per-row negative scorer lands well below 1.0 and the strong baseline == ~1.0 by construction.', 'max_score_time_sec': 'single-pass hang cap; set comfortably above the naive baseline pass time.', 'anti_cache_perturb_frac': 'fraction of held-out samples whose outputs are perturbed (with fresh probe:: ids) so a copied id->score lookup mis-scores; a scorer that actually reads inputs still matches.', 'score_consistency': 'confirm the strong baseline and the reference scorer agree EXACTLY on every held-out id (mismatched==0, missing==0) at atol; confirm a sample-skipping / approximate scorer fails the welded consistency gate -> 0.'} | 2026-07-27: strong_baseline_time_sec is now a DIAGNOSTIC only (the speedup denominator is the in-session ABBA baseline); the frozen reward denominator is ref_speedup=2.24419 (see the ref_speedup block; the archived 2.0427 belonged to the superseded cross-host-constant protocol).

ref_speedup.metric: median measured ABBA speedup of the STRONGEST reviewer reference solution over the strong baseline, under the SHIPPED verifier and the SHIPPED protocol (6 alternating ABBA pairs per run)
ref_speedup.oracle_impl: solution/ceiling_columnar.py (reviewer-only, NEVER in the image, NEVER run at scoring)

ceiling_arrow.note: SLOWER than the strong baseline on this host -> reward 0 via gate 5

strong_baseline_vs_itself.note: the pairing anchor: 2.1% below 1.0 with 6 pairs (was 7% with 5 pairs, hence the even pair count)

ref_speedup.supersedes: the pre-2026-07-27 archived ladder (calibrated_record.ladder_measured_same_host) put ceiling_fastmatch at 2.0427 and ceiling_columnar at 1.8932. Those were measured against a CROSS-HOST CONSTANT anchor (0.174827 s) on an earlier CPU-only session; under the new in-session ABBA protocol the ORDER REVERSES (columnar 2.244 > fastmatch 2.142). ref_speedup therefore uses the strongest reference AS MEASURED BY THE SHIPPED PROTOCOL.
ref_speedup.legality_check: ref_speedup 2.24419 >= 1.15 (reward.md 出题合法性约束) PASS
ref_speedup.hardware_caveat: 此 ref_speedup=2.24419 与 thresholds.strong_baseline_time_sec=0.174827 均在作者的 CPU 通道(Intel Sapphire Rapids, AVX-512-VNNI)上标定。verifier 会以 ABBA 配对现场重测强基线,所以比值相对可移植,但单核吞吐/向量宽度差异很大的机器仍会偏。oracle 实现随题包发布在 task/tests/oracles/,硬件不一致时请用 recalibrate_howto 重标该锚点。

recalibrate_howto.step1: docker run --rm -v "$PWD/tests:/tests:ro" -e VERIFIER_MODE=<tests/oracles 里的模式名> fai/e2e-h3-eval-scoring-throughput:oss bash /tests/test.sh
recalibrate_howto.step2: 从 /logs/verifier/benchmark_results.json 读 speedup(建议 >=3 次取中位数)
recalibrate_howto.guard: ref_speedup <= 1 或缺失 => 设计上 HARD FAIL 0
recalibrate_howto.dataset: 数据集由 task/environment/build_dataset.py 纯 stdlib + seed 20240725 确定性重建;build 时断言重生成的 heldout 与 b387c17... 逐字节一致 => 语料可证同一标定基准

reward_formula: reward = min(1.0, ln(speedup/ref_speedup)/ln(ref_speedup)) if speedup > ref_speedup else 0.0; range [0,1]; speedup = median over >=5 alternating ABBA pairs of baseline_time/candidate_time with the baseline RE-MEASURED in-session from oracles/strong_baseline_scoring_pipeline.py
abba_baseline_impl: oracles/strong_baseline_scoring_pipeline.py (byte-identical copy of solution/scoring_pipeline_ref.py; uploaded fresh under /tests, NEVER baked)
abba_ordering_note: 6 pairs (an EVEN count) on purpose: the within-pair order alternates BA/AB, and MEASURED a systematic ordering bias of ~1-8% on a single pair (baseline-vs-itself pair ratios 0.9153/1.0904/0.9894/0.9456/1.0833 in a control session). With an ODD pair count the median always lands on a base-first pair and inherits that bias; with an EVEN count it averages one pair of each order and the bias cancels.

trust_boundary_hardening.why: the candidate is loaded with importlib INTO the measuring process; the clock, the held-out workload, the harness's own reference scorer, the pass/fail accumulator and the reward function were all reachable module attributes
trust_boundary_hardening.fix: primitives bound before candidate import + _assert_pristine at 13 sites + frozen cfg reward keys; named reason cheating_harness_tamper
